changes.year2_quote_or_null: Loss of the bank holding company status, because of the restructuring, could make future acquisitions of financial institutions with such operations more challenging.
changes.reasoning: Candidate 1 reproduces the same economic risk and retains the specific limitations under the Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act, the bank-versus-bank-holding-company distinction, and the acquisition consequence. The wording change from “as a result” to “because of” is cosmetic and does not alter the disclosure.
changes.title: Financial Activity And Acquisition Limitations

changes.year1_quote: Shares of the Bank’s common stock are not a bank deposit and, therefore, losses in value are not insured by the FDIC, any other deposit insurance fund, or by any other public or private entity.
changes.year2_quote_or_null: Shares of our common stock are not a bank deposit and, therefore, losses in value are not insured by the FDIC, any other deposit insurance fund, or by any other public or private entity.
changes.reasoning: Candidate 1 preserves the same economic risk and all material specifics: the stock is not a deposit, losses are not covered by FDIC or other insurance, and the investment can lose principal. The changes are only issuer-reference and wording conventions.
changes.title: Common Stock Is Not An Insured Deposit

changes.year1_quote: The Bank is presented with various reputational risk issues that could stem from operational, regulatory/compliance and legal risks.
changes.year2_quote_or_null: We are presented with various reputational risk issues that could stem from operational, regulatory, compliance, and legal risks.
changes.reasoning: Candidate 1 retains the same underlying disclosure: reputational risk can arise from operational, regulatory/compliance, and legal risks. The added discussion of adverse publicity and the Reputational Risk Council supplements rather than changes or weakens the Year-2019 risk.
changes.title: Sources Of Reputational Risk

changes.year1_quote: A Reputational Risk Council was established to monitor, manage and develop strategies to effectively manage reputational risk which includes, but is not limited to, addressing communication logistics, legal and regulatory issues.
changes.year2_quote_or_null: A Reputational Risk Council was established to monitor, manage, and develop strategies to effectively manage reputational risk which includes, but is not limited to, addressing communication logistics, legal, and regulatory issues.
changes.reasoning: The Year-2020 Reputational Risk disclosure preserves the same council, oversight responsibilities, reputational-risk subject matter, and listed communication, legal, and regulatory issues. The added discussion of underlying operational, regulatory, compliance, and legal risks does not change or weaken the Year-2019 disclosure.
changes.title: Reputational Risk Council Oversight
